description: Wedderburn-strata enumeration for H_n(R, q) at q = q_0 ≈ 1.1097. For each n, lists every partition λ ⊢ n with depth, classical and q-deformed dimensions, signed content (chirality marker), and Plancherel weight w_λ = dim_q²/[n]_q!. Strata are grouped by curvature-rank depth = height(λ) - 1.
